title: Apply to be a candidate land or mining surveyor
summary: Apply to the NSW Board of Surveying and Spatial Information (BOSSI) to enrol as a candidate land or mining surveyor.
intro:
To enrol as a candidate surveyor, you'll need to apply to the NSW Board of Surveying and Spatial Information (BOSSI).

Before you apply, check the requirements for becoming a candidate land surveyor or candidate mining surveyor.

Enrolment is payable at the beginning of each financial year.
who_can_apply: Be enrolled to study for a recognised qualification.
what_you_need: A MyServiceNSW Account or OneGov account.
Certified copies of required documents in English and PDF format (max 4MB).
A passport quality photo in JPG format.
A credit or debit card for the enrolment fee.
If overseas, a BOSSI-specific Overseas Assessment.

how_to_steps.text: Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account, or log in using your OneGov credentials.
Follow the prompts to apply to be a candidate surveyor.

faqs.q: Who can apply to be a candidate surveyor?
faqs.a: You must either be enrolled to study for a recognised qualification or hold a recognised qualification.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to apply?
faqs.a: You need a MyServiceNSW or OneGov account, a passport quality photo (JPG), a credit or debit card for the fee, and if you are overseas, a BOSSI-specific Overseas Assessment.

faqs.q: How do I apply to be a candidate surveyor?
faqs.a: Gather your documents, select 'Apply online', start the application, and log in or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
